title: Fuga canonica in Epidiapente

captions.text: ☞ The dux: the royal theme in long notes, over a running bass.
☞ Comes: the flute plays the dux's line a fifth higher, ten bars later.
☞ The royal theme again, now in the bass, under the canon.
☞ The dux goes on alone; the flute finishes the canon ten bars behind.

listenFor: canon at the fifth above, ten bars apart, over a free bass

glossaryNotes.canon-at-an-interval: The bass is free: only the flute imitates, following the harpsichord's right hand.
